text.en: The family bakery was formerly known as Moderna Bakery.
A family account in 2011 described it as more than sixty years old; its exact founding year is unconfirmed.
That account describes the original tall brick pugon used for baking.
A 2009 visitor describes its pancit with lechon kawali.
